scope: Real compound core transactions, observed action plans, deterministic DOM/RAF lifecycle, synthetic audio-node accounting and user-gesture gating; no browser or human audible testing in this revision

tests.name: Every unit has a movement/weapon family and every active skill has its own effect
Movement follows the actual legal detour, not an invented straight line
A hidden collision truncates before the blocked tile and does not animate the planned endpoint
Enemy movement drops hidden coordinates and separates disconnected visible segments
A wholly hidden AI move creates no effects, sounds or observed unit metadata
Shots and countershots derive damage and order from the completed transaction
Lethal direct shots and indirect attacks never fabricate a countershot
Dedicated AA lethal retaliation uses its actual 150 percent loss
An unseen artillery attacker shows only an observed impact and own HP loss
Capture has observed ownership colors; building destruction keeps its original sprite metadata
All eight active skills receive their specific successful effect, with actual capped repair amount
Execution errors and mismatched observers cannot create successful action feedback
A complete visual action leaves the authoritative state untouched and restores original opacity
Pause freezes frame progress; resume finishes; cancel settles immediately even with RAF stopped
No board, detached board and disabled effects complete exactly once without hanging
Reduced motion and fast AI shorten motion, and abandoned playback is cleaned before the next one
Audio requires explicit unlock, respects mute/volume bounds, and rejected resumes do not escape
Real move -> automatic capture -> FIFO release retains each successful effect in core event order
Real end/begin transaction animates all produced units once and keeps deployment/turn ordering
Released hidden enemy production neither leaks its instance nor adds an audible deployment
One manual deployment is not duplicated; rolling 600-event buffers preserve compound effects
Queued auto-deploy sprites and top-layer labels stay hidden until their phase; cancellation restores all
Ambient classification uses only allowed terrain/building hints and ignores hidden-unit or arbitrary fields
Atmosphere stays bounded under repeated camera updates and stops/disconnects on pause, mute, scene exit and cancel
Observed action sounds pan within the current camera and leave no voice nodes after cancellation
